card.name: Microcontroller and chip spec sheets
card.fires_on: Pieces of numbers and chip names inside hardware spec text, such as ARM7TDMI, ARM11, 32-bit, MHz clock speeds, and Arduino board feature lists.

modes.label: Digits inside specs
modes.description: A digit or part of a number in a processor name, bit width, or clock speed.

modes.label: Linking words in board feature lists
modes.description: The word 'and' or 'an' or 'board' in lists of board connections and features.
modes.example: a micro USB connection, a power jack, an ICSP header,<< and>> a reset button.

modes.label: Inside ARM chip names
modes.description: A letter or digit partway through an ARM core name.
